validation input: Parse exactly one UTF-8 JSON value and reject duplicate object keys. Preserve numeric precision through validation.

Parse UTF-8 comma-separated records with standard quoting and a mandatory header. Use the header verbatim as ordered `columns` and each data record as an object in `rows`. Header names must be nonempty and unique. Reject records whose field count differs from the header. Preserve data cell strings, including empty strings and whitespace. Skip physically empty lines outside quoted fields.

Parse UTF-8 as CommonMark 0.31.2. Collect document-level headings in source order into `headings`, with parsed level and visible text from inline nodes. Strip markup and link destinations, include image alt text and inline code, turn inline breaks into spaces, trim edges and collapse whitespace runs. Headings inside containers such as quotes and lists stay outside this projection.
